stop_mechanism_proven: Installed parser rejected a complete CRC-valid 43-byte command with two NE-marked bytes while its discard budget was already 2/2.
fix: Withhold one CRC-valid multi-NE ENABLE packet only on an already running qualified link. Never execute it or refresh watchdog. Require a later clean fresh command within 100 ms; repeated noise or timeout stops. Existing 2/1000ms damaged-packet budget and 300ms watchdog retained.

sources.title: ST ES0431 Rev9 section2.12.2
sources.finding: Short low glitches in the second half of a stop bit may corrupt reception. ST specifies a noise-free line or external filtering.
sources.applicability: Potential mechanism only; not demonstrated on this stand.

sources.title: ST RM0440 USART data sampling
sources.finding: With majority sampling, disagreement between central samples sets NE. The hardware flag does not locate the external source.
sources.implementation: 16x oversampling, three-sample majority and NE detection unchanged.

confirmed_preparation: J1 off, independently measured bus below20V, both USB connected; motor and TP23/1k/PA4 retained; J4 may stay on
